item.title: Israel wants US to attack Iran, but Trump favours tough diplomacy: report
item.description: Israeli officials said Tel Aviv prefers that the US attack Iran, warning that refraining from such action would have "consequences."

item.title: Former UK envoy to US resigns from Labour Party over Epstein links
item.description: Peter Mandelson was sacked as ambassador in September 2025 due to his past connections to Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: Trump draws curtains on Kennedy Center arts complex for two years
item.description: Trump says it will be subject to approval of the board, which he handpicked upon taking over as chairman.

item.title: Nigerian troops kill key Boko Haram commander, ten other terrorists
item.description: Abu Khalid has been described as a key figure within the outlawed group, responsible for coordinating terrorist actions.

item.title: Two US federal agents identified in Minneapolis shooting: report
item.description: Both agents were deployed as part of “Operation Metro Surge”, a sweeping immigration enforcement operation launched in December.

item.title: Bad Bunny shouts 'ICE out' to cheers at Grammys
item.description: Last week, Trump said he would skip this year’s Super Bowl, citing dissatisfaction with the artists chosen to perform at the halftime show, including Bad Bunny.

item.title: South Korean defence giant eyes broader Nordic security partnership following Norway rocket deal
item.description: Hanwha Aerospace will supply 16 Chunmoo MRLS units to the Norwegian Armed Forces.

item.title: Measles sparks lockdown at Texas ICE detention centre
item.description: Two confirmed infections halt all internal movement at the Dilley facility, intensifying scrutiny of health risks inside an expanding US immigration detention system.

item.title: Oil slides, dollar climbs on US-Iran diplomatic hopes
item.description: Markets slipped as oil and metals dropped following possible negotiations between Washington and Tehran over the nuclear deal and Trump’s hawkish Federal Reserve pick.

item.title: Daily News Brief | 2 February
item.description: UN chief says a silent war is unfolding in the occupied West Bank amid Israeli killings and home demolitions. And, Iran’s Foreign Minister says nuclear talks can resume if trust and sanctions relief are addressed.
